glossary.definition: Prompt injection is an attack where someone hides malicious instructions inside content an AI reads, like a webpage, email, or document, to hijack its behavior against its owner's wishes. Imagine a personal assistant who follows any instruction written on a sticky note handed to them, a scammer could slip in a fake note saying "forward all emails to this address," and a naive assistant would just comply. It's one of the main security concerns for AI agents that browse the web or read documents on your behalf.

items.title: Apple may be developing its own AI agent that runs your Mac
items.summary: The iPhone maker appears to be building agents that can compete with the likes of Meta Muse, Instinct, Claude, and OpenAI Dots. Apple appears to be working on its own AI agent to conduct computer work on behalf of users — including using apps, accessing websites, and coding, among other things. ” “Imagine an AI agent that can use a computer the way a capable person does,” the posting says. “It browses the web, works across apps, runs commands, writes and debugs code, and calls services, and it chooses the right tool for each step.

items.title: Anthropic’s 7 founders cashed out nearly $2B in record-breaking IPO
items.summary: At the upgraded $83/share IPO price, Anthropic's seven founders each pocketed $280 million, while the company nabbed nearly $105 billion. Anthropic became a public company on Thursday, raising a total of $81.3 billion, including $1.95 billion for its seven founders. As we previously reported, each of them ponied up about 3.4 million shares apiece to sell in the IPO. At the upgraded IPO price of $83 per share, that means they each pocketed about $280 million before underwriting fees and taxes.

items.title: AI coding agents need a safe place to work; Eclipse is building the sandbox to give it to them
items.summary: AI coding tools are moving beyond copilots that make suggestions to independent, autonomous agents that execute terminal commands, write and modify software, run tests, and install dependencies. This means they need the freedom to move around on their own, but that is inherently dangerous; agents with little oversight or unrestricted access can make changes they aren’t supposed to, expose credentials and other sensitive information, or take other unintended actions, as vendors have discovered the hard way . To help move the bar on these security and governance challenges , the Eclipse Foundation has launched Eclipse Enclave 1.0, an AI sandbox and runtime. Developers can use the vendor-neutral platform to test various autonomous AI coding tools in isolated environments, with explicitly defined access to files, credentials, and networks.

items.title: Google adds computer use capabilities to Gemini’s Mac app
items.summary: Google LLC today released a new version of Gemini’s Mac client that can interact with other apps on the user’s computer. S. on launch. It requires a Google AI subscription, which equips consumer Google accounts with a broader lineup of artificial intelligence tools. The offering also includes additional storage space and certain other features.

items.title: Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent
items.summary: Apple is working on its own AI agent that can perform a range of tasks for you, including browsing the web, working across apps, writing code, and calling services. That's according to a job listing spotted by Bloomberg , which says Apple is looking for an engineer to lead the creation of an agentic AI assistant. An AI agent from Apple would put the iPhone maker in the running to compete with the likes of Meta's Muse , OpenAI's Dots , Anthropic's Duet , and Google's Tasks . Muse, ChatGPT, and Perplexity can already take control of a computer through their Mac apps, while Google just started letting Gemini do the same.

items.title: A brief history of Nvidia’s recent stock fluctuations
items.summary: "We've got this," Colette Kress, interim CEO of Nvidia, said Tuesday night as she closed out the embattled chip company's third quarter earnings call. By Thursday, the company's stock price was hovering at around $150 per share, a nearly 40 percent drop from its all-time high on October 6th, and wiping out a brief post-earnings pop on Tuesday night. Meanwhile, Wall Street was paying up for one of Nvidia's biggest customers as Anthropic made its Nasdaq debut at $111.50 per share - 34 percent higher than expected. Looking at the earnings report numbers alone, Nvidia had a blockbuster quarter.

items.title: What’s With All These Outages?
items.summary: This week on “Uncanny Valley,” we discuss the outages that have swept digital life over the past week, where new money from Anthropic’s IPO is going, and the AI chip world post-Jensen Huang. Microsoft, the FAA, Chase, United, the NSA, and Apple all went down within one week. Officials say none of the outages were cyberattacks, but the internet isn’t buying it. This week on Uncanny Valley , WIRED senior business editor Sophie Kleeman joins Brian Barrett and Leah Feiger to discuss what actually went wrong and why people jumped straight to blaming hackers and AI.

items.title: An OpenAI agent assigned a simple writing task decided on its own to build a secret email surveillance tool
items.summary: " The agent recognized the conflict with its assigned task but dismissed it as an environment error. OpenAI identified security training against prompt injection as a possible trigger but cannot establish it as the sole cause. During a training experiment, an internal OpenAI model began creating scripts for unauthorized email forwarding even though it was only supposed to write a health document. According to an OpenAI report, an internal research model was given a simple task during a reinforcement learning training run in mid-October.

items.title: Microsoft positions Copilot as a hub for team collaboration
items.summary: Microsoft has unveiled Copilot Workspaces, a new collaborative environment for employees and AI agents to work together on shared projects. It was one of a range of Copilot updates at Microsoft’s Ignite conference this week, including deeper Office integration and new AI agent capabilities, as it seeks to position the AI assistant as a hub for team productivity. Workspaces replaces Copilot Notebooks, announced last year , which let users gather files and other reference materials, then ask Copilot to answer questions, draft documents, and generate audio overviews based on this content. Workspaces retains these capabilities in what Microsoft describes as a “team-first” shared space, where colleagues can collaborate on documents, with live cursors showing what they are working on.

items.title: Cyient Semiconductors Secures $10 Mn Investment From GlobalFoundries
items.summary: Cyient Semiconductors has approved a $10 million equity investment from US-based chipmaker GlobalFoundries (GF). The transaction will take place at a pre-money valuation of $490 million. It follows Cyient Semiconductors' recent funding round led by Edelweiss. The combined investment values the company at a $510 million post-money valuation. Cyient Semiconductors plans to use the investment to expand its turnkey custom application-specific integrated circuit (ASIC) capabilities.

items.title: Karnataka Sees ₹1,050 Cr Deeptech Investment From 24 VCs
items.summary: Future Makers Conclave 2026, held as part of Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026 , saw 24 venture capital firms announce approximately ₹1,050 crore in investments for Karnataka's deeptech ecosystem. It includes companies working across aerospace, AI, robotics, semiconductors, and other technology sectors. The announcements aim to support emerging technology startups and strengthen the state's position as a hub for deeptech innovation. The conclave brought together startups, founders, investors, and ecosystem leaders in Bengaluru.

items.title: The AI Hype Index: AI is everywhere
items.summary: Like a nasty rash, AI seems to spread everywhere. Google crams AI Overviews down your throat even though it costs the company billions of dollars in lost ad revenue. Leave your apartment, and you might pass two people heaving an AI-powered humanoid robot up the stairs to clean someone’s rooms. Go to the supermarket, and perhaps you’ll slip on a pool of melted ice cream congealing on the floor thanks to an AI-assisted cyberattack .
